mapper.select: SELECT USER_NO AS userNo, USER_ID AS userId, EMAIL AS email, PASSWORD AS password, NICKNAME AS nickname, PHONE AS phone, ROLE AS role, STATUS AS status, TEMP_PASSWORD_YN AS tempPasswordYn, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, DELETED_AT AS deletedAt, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS profileImageUrl, PROFILE_IMAGE_NAME AS profileImageName, PROFILE_IMAGE_EXT AS profileImageExt, PROFILE_IMAGE_MIME_TYPE AS profileImageMimeType, PROFILE_IMAGE_SIZE AS profileImageSize, PROFILE_IMAGE_DATA AS profileImageData FROM OFT_USERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(USER_ID)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{value})) OR UPPER(TRIM(EMAIL)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{value}))

SELECT USER_NO AS userNo, USER_ID AS userId, EMAIL AS email, PASSWORD AS password, NICKNAME AS nickname, PHONE AS phone, ROLE AS role, STATUS AS status, TEMP_PASSWORD_YN AS tempPasswordYn, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, DELETED_AT AS deletedAt, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS profileImageUrl, PROFILE_IMAGE_NAME AS profileImageName, PROFILE_IMAGE_EXT AS profileImageExt, PROFILE_IMAGE_MIME_TYPE AS profileImageMimeType, PROFILE_IMAGE_SIZE AS profileImageSize, PROFILE_IMAGE_DATA AS profileImageData FROM OFT_USERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(EMAIL)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{email})) AND REPLACE(TRIM(PHONE), '-', '') = REPLACE(TRIM(#{phone}), '-', '')

SELECT USER_NO AS userNo, USER_ID AS userId, EMAIL AS email, PASSWORD AS password, NICKNAME AS nickname, PHONE AS phone, ROLE AS role, STATUS AS status, TEMP_PASSWORD_YN AS tempPasswordYn, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, DELETED_AT AS deletedAt, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS profileImageUrl, PROFILE_IMAGE_NAME AS profileImageName, PROFILE_IMAGE_EXT AS profileImageExt, PROFILE_IMAGE_MIME_TYPE AS profileImageMimeType, PROFILE_IMAGE_SIZE AS profileImageSize, PROFILE_IMAGE_DATA AS profileImageData FROM OFT_USERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(EMAIL)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{value}))

SELECT USER_NO AS userNo, USER_ID AS userId, EMAIL AS email, PASSWORD AS password, NICKNAME AS nickname, PHONE AS phone, ROLE AS role, STATUS AS status, TEMP_PASSWORD_YN AS tempPasswordYn, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, DELETED_AT AS deletedAt, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS profileImageUrl, PROFILE_IMAGE_NAME AS profileImageName, PROFILE_IMAGE_EXT AS profileImageExt, PROFILE_IMAGE_MIME_TYPE AS profileImageMimeType, PROFILE_IMAGE_SIZE AS profileImageSize, PROFILE_IMAGE_DATA AS profileImageData FROM OFT_USERS WHERE USER_NO = #{value}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OFT_USERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(USER_ID)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{value}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OFT_USERS ( USER_ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, NICKNAME, PHONE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{phone} )
mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_NO AS userNo, u.USER_ID AS userId, u.NICKNAME AS nickname, u.EMAIL AS email, u.PHONE AS phone, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS profileImageUrl, ( SELECT TRIM(a.ADDRESS1 || ' ' || NVL(a.ADDRESS2, '')) FROM OFT_USER_ADDRESS a WHERE a.USER_NO = u.USER_NO AND a.IS_DEFAULT = 'Y' ) AS defaultAddress, NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(oi.SAVED_AMOUNT, 0)) FROM OFT_ORDERS o JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.USER_NO = u.USER_NO ), 0) AS totalSavedAmount FROM OFT_USERS u WHERE u.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND u.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OFT_USERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(EMAIL)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{email})) AND USER_NO != #{userNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OFT_USERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(NICKNAME)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{nickname})) AND USER_NO != #{userNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE OFT_USERS SET NICKNAME = #{nickname}, EMAIL = #{email}, PHONE = #{phone}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE OFT_USERS SET PASSWORD = #{newPassword}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE OFT_USERS SET PASSWORD = #{password}, TEMP_PASSWORD_YN = 'Y', UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
UPDATE OFT_USERS SET PASSWORD = #{password}, TEMP_PASSWORD_YN = 'N', UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
